channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Trabuco Hills girls basketball beats La Serna with big surge at the end
item.description: Trabuco Hills outscores La Serna 28-6 in the final period to secure the victory in the first round of the CIF-SS Division 3 playoffs.

item.title: USC women beat Indiana to extend win streak to 5 games
item.description: Jazzy Davidson has 24 points, Kara Dunn scores 16 and Kennedy Smith adds 15 as the Trojans rely on stingy defense and a strong showing at the free-throw line to outlast the Hoosiers, 79-73.

item.title: El Dorado girls soccer tops Los Alamitos with late goal from Jialynn Davenport
item.description: Davenport breaks a scoreless tie with a goal in the 78th minute, sending the Golden Hawks on to the second round of the CIF-SS Division 1 playoffs.

item.title: LeBron James becomes oldest to record a triple-double as Lakers top Mavericks
item.description: The 41-year-old James finishes with 28 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds in a 124-104 victory, giving the Lakers seven wins in their past 11 games as they head into the All-Star break.

item.title: Surging Cal State Fullerton men outlast Long Beach State
item.description: Joshua Ward (22 points) makes two free throws with 16.8 seconds left to break a tie and two more with 3.6 seconds remaining to seal an 86-82 victory, the Titans’ fifth win in six games and their first regular-season sweep of LBSU since the 2019-20 season.

item.title: Madi Lam leads Santa Margarita girls basketball past Esperanza in playoffs
item.description: Lam records a triple-double against her former school to help push Santa Margarita to a first-round win in CIF-SS Division 1.

item.title: Portola girls basketball knocks off Paramount in first round of CIF-SS playoffs
item.description: Portola senior guard Kara Niho scores a game-high 20 points and makes five of the team's 15 3-pointers in the contest.

item.title: Beckman girls soccer shows Brea Olinda why it’s the top seed in Division 2
item.description: Beckman dominates throughout the first-round contest as Riley O’Brien, Caitlyn Chweh and Devenee Ceja each score a goal in the victory.

item.title: Girls basketball playoffs: Sage Hill, Orange Lutheran, Troy win first-round games
item.description: OCVarsity's roundup has the highlights from the girls basketball games Thursday in the CIF-SS playoffs.

item.title: Villa Park girls basketball overpowers Palos Verdes from the start
item.description: All five starters for Villa Park score in double figures as the team starts out strong and rolls to a victory to begin the CIF-SS Division 1 playoffs.
